subject: Isolated deployment: clarification on architecture tradeoffs and staffing
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: Isolated deploy ask from Greenbank — initial info request

Team,

Greenbank (ops@greenbank.com) asked if we can support an "isolated" private deployment — essentially VPC + on-prem connector with no outbound telemetry and a customer-controlled KMS. They want a short feasibility assessment to include:

- High-level architecture variants (hosted private vs full on-prem appliance)
- Expected infra & engineering staffing to support pilot (3-month runway)
- SLAs we could reasonably offer without major product changes
- Compliance/controls gaps (SOC2, audit logs, retention)

I've attached the cost model they sent as a starting point: greenbank_deploy_cost_model.xlsx (spreadsheet).

Please reply with the following by EOD Thursday if possible:
1) Karthik — one-paragraph note on major technical blockers and an estimated FTE range.
2) Soojin — product/operational gating questions and a recommended minimal feature set for pilot.
3) Grace/Marcus — any commercial or intake constraints we should flag (commits, discounts, or SLA exceptions).

This is time-sensitive; Greenbank has an internal procurement window the week of Sep 20.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Manager, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachment: greenbank_deploy_cost_model.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Isolated deploy ask from Greenbank — initial info request

Naomi — quick notes below. Quoted original below for context.

Summary (short): technically feasible with two plausible paths — (A) Private control plane in our hosted region + customer VPC peering and strict egress controls; (B) On-prem lightweight runtime (containerized) with no external telemetry. Path A is lower effort but requires a hardened data path and KMS integration; Path B has higher ops burden and adds packaging/OS compatibility matrix.

Key blockers/unknowns:
- KMS integration: GKIP/HSM options vary by customer; we need an HSM/CMEK design (+~0.5–1.0 FTE infra to implement).
- Logging/audit: removing all telemetry means we lose runtime metrics; need an alternative for health checks and billing reconciliation.
- Model artifacts & size: some of our larger quantized models exceed tight on-prem constraints — may need smaller variants or sharding.

Estimated staffing for 3-month pilot (assumes project owner + 3-month scope):
- Infra eng: 1.5 FTE (runtime packaging, KMS integration, network config)
- Platform/serving: 1.0 FTE (runtime adaptations, quantization profile)
- SRE/Oncall setup: 0.5 FTE (runbook, rollback, escalation)
- Program/Product coordination: 0.5 FTE

So roughly 3.5–4.5 FTEs for pilot runway to get to a supported P1 pilot. If we pick path A (hosted control plane) we shave ~1.0 FTE and reduce long-term ops burden.

I've attached a short note with architecture sketches: isolation_arch_notes.pdf

—Karthik

Attachment: isolation_arch_notes.pdf (PDF)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Isolated deploy ask from Greenbank — initial info request

Thanks Karthik — useful framing. Adding product/ops perspective:

Minimal pilot scope we should push for (to reduce unknowns):
- Limit initial workload to embeddings + low-rate chat (no high-throughput batch generation).
- Use a single medium-sized model variant (quantized) we already have vetted for on-prem execution.
- Define a clear rollback and data-purge policy owned by the customer but with a Redwood verification step.

Operational gating items:
- Support window: we can offer business-hours support for pilot; 24x7 requires dedicated SRE rotation (add 1.0 FTE ongoing).
- Billing & metering: if telemetry is restricted, we need a reconciliation protocol (signed usage summaries from customer and cryptographic attestations).
- Compliance: Greenbank asked for SOC2 artifacts; we can provide exported evidence but not live telemetry. See attached checklist: soc2_evidence_checklist.docx.

Recommendation: propose Path A (hosted private control-plane) for pilot with a clear list of telemetry exceptions documented in the contract. It buys us a lot of operational simplicity while satisfying the customer's isolation requirement.

Open questions for leadership/commercial:
1) What is our discount / commitment threshold for taking on pilot risk? (Marcus/Grace)
2) Are we comfortable with customer-supplied oncall during pilot if they insist on no outbound connections?

—Soojin

Attachment: soc2_evidence_checklist.docx (docx)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-18T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Isolated deploy ask from Greenbank — initial info request

Team — thanks for the fast turn. A few commercial notes and next steps: 

- Pricing: if the customer wants our engineering commitment and a pilot SLA, we'll need a minimum 6-month paid pilot or a pilot fee to cover ~2 FTEs of effort. Recommend we propose a pilot fee of $85k + monthly support retainer.
- Escalation: if any compliance gaps require legal exceptions (e.g., exception to telemetry policies), escalate to me and Marcus immediately. We will need Security & Legal to sign off and that adds ~2 week lead time.
- Procurement timeline: I will block a 30-minute alignment call with Greenbank procurement for Mon Sep 21 — Naomi please confirm availability.

Next steps (action owners):
- Naomi: confirm customer willingness on pilot fee and proposed pilot scope.
- Karthik: produce a two-page tech appendix (path A vs B, FTE estimate) by Friday 09/19.
- Soojin: draft minimal pilot SLOs and a telemetry exception appendix.
- Marcus: draft commercial terms (pilot fee and support retainer).

If the numbers look like >$200k of committed effort or require more than 6 FTE-months up-front, escalate to leadership for approval.

—Grace O'Connor
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
